title: BD-AgriKG: A Knowledge Graph and Bilingual Text2Cypher Benchmark for Crop Suitability and Productivity in Bangladesh
description: Knowledge graph of crop suitability and productivity in Bangladesh (BARC land suitability, BAMIS agro-meteorology, BBS crop calendar, SRDI soils and a 12-year district production panel from BBS yearbooks, on an OCHA COD-AB P-code spine), with the first English and Bangla execution-based Text2Cypher benchmark (460 questions, 26 templates), the evaluation harness and the per-item outputs of seven large language models. Companion release of the paper accepted at NORA 2026 (AACL-IJCNLP 2026). v1.0 is the data as evaluated; v1.1 adds the corrections of a post-review audit, listed in CHANGELOG.md. Code is MIT-licensed; derived data is CC BY 4.0.
